info.name: Project Management API
info.description: Keep in sync with the API contract (see CLAUDE.md). Run 'Get CSRF cookie' first, then Login.

exec: // Django enforces CSRF on unsafe methods: send the token as X-CSRFToken.
// {{csrf_token}} is stored by "Get CSRF cookie"; fall back to the cookie.

request.description: Call first. Sets the csrftoken cookie and returns the token as data.csrf_token; the test script stores it in {{csrf_token}} and the collection pre-request script sends it as X-CSRFToken.
Neutral reply whether or not the email exists.

What Google posts after its sign-in page (response_mode=form_post). Answers 302 to /app on success or /login?google_error=... on failure. The pg_google_state cookie must equal the state field, and the token's nonce must equal the part of state before the dot.
current_password is optional for social-only accounts.
Token from the link in the email. No login needed. Signs out every session; log in again with the new address.
Multipart. JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 2 MB.
Your own account security log, newest first. Filter with event_type.
Send password, or id_token for a Google account. A confirmation link goes to the new address (check the server console in development); the old address is warned.
Mark the onboarding walkthrough as done (`tour_completed` becomes true).
Reset the walkthrough so it runs again.
Caller becomes owner. Stores {{project_id}} and {{join_code}}.
Paginated (limit/offset). Includes the caller's role.
Each field needs its permission (owner only for now). is_listed is owner only.
Owner only. Send password, or id_token (fresh Google sign-in) for social-only accounts. 7-day undo.
Owner only, needs password or id_token. Pending requests survive.
Copy a demo project (`is_demo`) into a new unlisted project you own. Optional `name`. At most 3 copies per user (`copy_limit_reached`), 5 per hour. Non-demo projects: `copy_not_allowed`.
Emails and full names are visible to the owner only.
Needs member.remove. reassign maps an owned-item type to the member who inherits it; types left out become unassigned.
Members only. The owner must transfer ownership first.
Wrong codes: 5 per hour per user and per IP. Stores {{join_request_id}}.
Owner only. Optional ?status=pending|approved|rejected|expired.
Optional starting permissions: {"preset": "contributor"} or {"permissions": ["note.create"]}. Default none. Giving any needs permissions.manage and only codes you hold. Send {} for none.
The requester may ask again after 24 hours.
Owner only. Target must be a member. Needs password or id_token. Stores {{transfer_id}}.
Pending transfers offered to the caller.
Only the target member can accept.
Seeded: To do, In progress, In review, Done, Cancelled.
Owner only (until feature 5). category: todo | in_progress | done. Stores {{status_id}}.
name, category, position (renumbers siblings), is_default. A category must keep at least one status.
Needs move_to (another status id) when tasks use it. The default status and the last one in a category cannot be deleted.
Seeded: Low, Medium, High, Urgent (rank 1-4).
Owner only (until feature 5). Stores {{priority_id}}.
Needs move_to when tasks use it.
Only title is required. status and priority default to the project's defaults (send ids to override). Stores {{task_number}}.

Paginated. Filters (all optional): status, priority, assignee (ids), tag, q (title search), due_date_after, due_date_before, overdue, top_level. ordering: number|title|due_date|priority|created_at|updated_at, prefix - to reverse. meta carries server_time and server_date.
Addressed by number; the key (APL-1) is only for display.
Each field needs its permission; one 403 lists every forbidden field. parent: a task number, or null to promote a subtask. A parent cannot enter a Done status while subtasks are open.
Soft delete (7-day undo) that also deletes its subtasks. Creator or owner.
Brings back the task and the subtasks deleted with it.
Tasks assigned to the caller across projects. Same filters, ordering and meta as the project list.
One level only: a subtask cannot have subtasks.
Body is raw markdown, 100 KB maximum. @[user:<id>] mentions email that member. Stores {{note_id}}.
Paginated, without bodies.
Send the version you started from. A stale version returns 409 stale_data.
Newest first; one row per save.
Oldest first. Deleted comments stay as placeholders with body null.
Stores {{comment_id}}.
Your own comments; the owner can moderate others.
Defaults to group_by=status, sort_by=number.
group_by: status|priority|assignee|tag. sort_by: due_date|priority|created_at|updated_at|number|title.

target_type: task | note | comment. target: a task number, or a note/comment id. Declare the exact size and type. Stores {{attachment_id}} and {{upload_url}}. Then PUT the file (same Content-Type, exactly that many bytes) to the URL, outside this API, and call Confirm.
Call after the PUT. The server checks the size, sniffs the real file type and either marks it ready (images are re-encoded first and show as processing) or deletes it.
Ready and processing files. Filter with ONE of task (number), note (id) or comment (id).
Returns a signed link valid for 5 minutes. Images open inline, everything else downloads.
The uploader or the owner. Frees quota and removes the file.
Project usage, quota, and breakdown by category and uploader.
Your usage across all projects against your personal 100 MB allowance.
Every permission with label, description and group, the presets (viewer, contributor, manager) and the owner-only actions. Generated by the backend; the frontend keeps no copy.
Visible to the owner, anyone with permissions.manage, and the member themselves. Returns the held codes and the matching preset name (or null).
Needs permissions.manage. The whole set is replaced; every code added or removed must be one you hold yourself, otherwise 403 cannot_grant_permission. The owner cannot be targeted.
Send either preset or permissions, not both.
200 only if the database and cache respond, otherwise 503. No login needed.
Health of the project's integrations (never tokens). Needs integration.logs.view or the provider's manage permission.
Revokes the token at the provider and wipes it here. Needs the provider's manage permission.
Outbound deliveries and how they went. Filter with status=pending|success|failed.
Sends a failed delivery again from the start.

"Channels the bot can see. is_member must be true to map one: invite the bot in Slack first."

request.description: enabled_events: task_created, task_updated, task_assigned, task_due_soon, task_overdue, comment_added, member_joined, member_removed, project_archived, join_request_created. Public channels return warn_public.

body.raw: "Returns {url, linked_workspaces}. Open the url in the browser to sign in with Slack."
"The five personal events with slack_dm (default true) and email (stored, inactive)."

body.raw: "Listed, unarchived projects you are not in. Newest listing first."
"The most used tags among listed projects."
